caption:
What would you say?

A teammate shared an idea in your team meeting. Ten minutes later, someone else repeated it like it was theirs and got the credit. The first teammate went quiet.

You’re about to speak to the person who took the idea.

What is your first sentence?

Ours goes in the comments on Monday.

#newmanager #leadership #management
monday_comment: Ours: “In the meeting, you repeated Maya’s idea as your own and she went quiet. I need you to give credit clearly when an idea came from someone else.”
